package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"reflect"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	SubjectPlanningStateChanged      = "student.planning-state.changed.v1"
	TriggerPlanningObjectiveEvidence = "OBJECTIVE_EVIDENCE"
	TriggerPlanningLearningIntent    = "LEARNING_INTENT"
	MaximumPlanningStateEventBytes   = 256 << 10
)

// PlanningStateChangedData is committed owner provenance, never a replanning
// command or raw evidence/mastery body. Planner reads the latest owner snapshot.
type PlanningStateChangedData struct {
	LearningPathID  string              `json:"learning_path_id"`
	PathVersion     int64               `json:"path_version"`
	TriggerKind     string              `json:"trigger_kind"`
	TriggerIdentity string              `json:"trigger_identity"`
	Targets         []LearningTargetRef `json:"targets"`
}

func PlanningStateChangedEventID(studentID, pathID, kind, identity string) string {
	return uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceURL, []byte(SubjectPlanningStateChanged+":"+studentID+":"+pathID+":"+kind+":"+identity)).String()
}

func NewPlanningStateChangedEvent(studentID, pathID string, pathVersion int64, kind, identity string, targets []LearningTargetRef, occurredAt time.Time) (IntegrationEvent, error) {
	occurredAt = occurredAt.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	normalized, err := NormalizePlanningSnapshotTargets(targets)
	if err != nil || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(studentID) || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(pathID) || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(identity) || pathVersion < 1 || occurredAt.IsZero() || (kind != TriggerPlanningObjectiveEvidence && kind != TriggerPlanningLearningIntent) {
		return IntegrationEvent{}, ErrValidation
	}
	event, err := NewIntegrationEvent(PlanningStateChangedEventID(studentID, pathID, kind, identity), SubjectPlanningStateChanged, pathID, identity, studentID, occurredAt, 1, PlanningStateChangedData{pathID, pathVersion, kind, identity, normalized})
	if err != nil {
		return IntegrationEvent{}, err
	}
	if err := ValidatePlanningStateChangedEvent(event); err != nil {
		return IntegrationEvent{}, err
	}
	return event, nil
}

func ValidatePlanningStateChangedEvent(event IntegrationEvent) error {
	if event.Subject != SubjectPlanningStateChanged || len(event.Payload) == 0 || len(event.Payload) > MaximumPlanningStateEventBytes {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(event.Payload))
	if err := planningStateJSONValue(dec, 0); err != nil {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := dec.Token(); err != io.EOF {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	var envelope EventEnvelope
	if err := decodeDiagnosticEvent(event.Payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	var data PlanningStateChangedData
	if err := decodeDiagnosticEvent(envelope.Data, &data); err != nil {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	targets, err := NormalizePlanningSnapshotTargets(data.Targets)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(targets, data.Targets) || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(data.LearningPathID) || data.PathVersion < 1 || !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(data.TriggerIdentity) || (data.TriggerKind != TriggerPlanningObjectiveEvidence && data.TriggerKind != TriggerPlanningLearningIntent) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if !IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(envelope.StudentID) || envelope.EventID != PlanningStateChangedEventID(envelope.StudentID, data.LearningPathID, data.TriggerKind, data.TriggerIdentity) || envelope.EventType != SubjectPlanningStateChanged || envelope.SchemaVersion != 1 || envelope.CorrelationID != data.LearningPathID || envelope.CausationID != data.TriggerIdentity || !canonicalDiagnosticTimestamp(envelope.OccurredAt) || event.EventID != envelope.EventID || event.StudentID != envelope.StudentID || event.CorrelationID != envelope.CorrelationID || event.CausationID != envelope.CausationID || event.SchemaVersion != envelope.SchemaVersion || !event.OccurredAt.Equal(envelope.OccurredAt) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

// Reject duplicate object fields and nulls before typed decoding can discard
// them. Typed strict decoding separately rejects unrecognized wire fields.
func planningStateJSONValue(dec *json.Decoder, depth int) error {
	if depth > 6 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	token, err := dec.Token()
	if err != nil || token == nil {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	delimiter, composite := token.(json.Delim)
	if !composite {
		return nil
	}
	switch delimiter {
	case '{':
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		for dec.More() {
			token, err := dec.Token()
			key, ok := token.(string)
			if err != nil || !ok || seen[key] || !planningStateJSONKey(depth, key) {
				return ErrValidation
			}
			seen[key] = true
			if err := planningStateJSONValue(dec, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		token, err := dec.Token()
		if err != nil || token != json.Delim('}') {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	case '[':
		for dec.More() {
			if err := planningStateJSONValue(dec, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		token, err := dec.Token()
		if err != nil || token != json.Delim(']') {
			return ErrValidation
		}
	default:
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func planningStateJSONKey(depth int, key string) bool {
	switch depth {
	case 0:
		switch key {
		case "event_id", "event_type", "correlation_id", "causation_id", "student_id", "occurred_at", "schema_version", "data":
			return true
		}
	case 1:
		switch key {
		case "learning_path_id", "path_version", "trigger_kind", "trigger_identity", "targets":
			return true
		}
	case 3:
		switch key {
		case "type", "key", "version":
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
